title: When AI Reviews Its Own Code: Recursive Self-Training Collapse in Code LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2606.28438v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recursive self-training can degrade neural generative models when generated data is reused without fresh human data or external quality control. We study this risk in code LLMs, where AI-generated code can enter real repositories, later become training data, and create a repository-scale self-training loop. While software development traditionally interrupts this loop through pull-request review, tests, compilation, and human approval, AI coding tools now produce code faster than humans can review it, and code review itself is increasingly automated by AI systems. We therefore compare three recursive fine-tuning regimes: no review, human-style exogenous-gate review using model-independent filters such as compilation and static quality checks, and AI-self-gate review using the code LLM's own signals such as perplexity and binary self-scoring. translated_title: 当AI审查自己的代码时：代码大语言模型中的递归自训练崩溃
translated_abstract: 当生成的数据在没有新鲜人类数据或外部质量控制的情况下被重复使用时，递归自训练可能导致神经生成模型性能退化。我们在代码大语言模型中研究这一风险：AI生成的代码可以进入真实代码仓库，随后成为训练数据，从而形成仓库规模的自我训练循环。虽然软件开发传统上通过拉取请求审查、测试、编译和人工批准来中断这一循环，但AI编程工具现在生成代码的速度已超过人类审查的速度，而代码审查本身也日益由AI系统自动化完成。因此，我们比较了三种递归微调模式：无审查、使用模型无关过滤器（如编译和静态质量检查）的类人类外部门控审查，以及使用代码大语言模型自身信号（如困惑度和二元自评分）的AI自我门控审查。在多个代码大语言模型和基准测试上，所有被测试的递归模式都低于其
tldr: 该论文首次在仓库规模情境下系统比较无审查、外部门控审查与AI自我门控审查三种递归微调模式，揭示了AI生成代码回流为训练数据时，即便有AI自我审查也无法阻止代码大语言模型的递归自训练崩溃。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares three recursive fine-tuning regimes—no review, human-style exogenous-gate review, and AI-self-gate review—revealing that when AI-generated code flows back into training data at repository scale, recursive self-training collapse occurs in code LLMs even with AI self-review in place.
